subject: Ticket 78: absolute-spelled rule never matches a tilde-spelled command
description: normalize_path collapses toward ~ but never expands it, so matching is asymmetric: a deny rule written with an absolute path does not fire on the ~ spelling. Bash-only; file-path tools are symmetric and safe. Needs a fourth tilde-expanded variant, accumulated not substituted. Caveats from the ticket: every added variant widens what BOTH allow and deny catch, and ~ expansion depends on home resolution which can fail — a variant that raises during matching is worse than the gap it closes.
